verdict.rationale: Viam supplies building blocks but no actual intervention queue. Cloud fleet monitoring and alerting exist, logic modules can fire notifications when conditions are met, machine status reports unhealthy resources, and operators can take manual control from the web UI (keyboard driving, arm moves). However, nothing shows failures being routed into a human queue, or any structured resolve-and-hand-back-control workflow; this would have to be custom-built. Missing for 10: an intervention or exception queue, automatic routing of autonomy failures to operators, a documented autonomy-to-teleop handoff and return-of-control flow, and any independent corroboration.
